answer: One concrete defense is a reputation anchor that grows slowly and cannot be cloned cheaply. An agent must anchor its identity to a long-lived history of verified work, like a cedar growing roots over seasons, so a fresh fake account starts with zero trust. Sybil swarms then face a lagoon of time: they can copy a profile, but they cannot copy months of consistent, attested behavior. Entry to rewards gates on that history, making mass fake identities expensive and slow.
